channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Ballymacelligot come good in second-half against Buttevant to claim Munster club JFC crown
item.description: Ballymacelligot (Kerry) are Munster club junior football champions after seeing off Buttevant (Cork) by 3-12 to 0-8 in Mallow this afternoon.

item.title: An Ghaeltacht see off Aghabollogue for second Munster club IFC success
item.description: An Ghaeltacht (Kerry) captured their second Munster club intermediate football championship title with a 2-12 to 1-8 win over Aghabollogue (Cork) in Rathkeale this afternoon.

item.title: Watch: Goals help 'Boden past Athy to third Leinster club SFC title
item.description: Ballyboden St Enda's claimed their third Leinster club senior football championship title thanks to a 2-18 to 1-14 win against at Athy at Croke Park.

item.title: Stafford the hero as St Martin's pip Ballyhale Shamrocks to Leinster glory
item.description: Ben Stafford's point in the third minute of injury-time saw St Martin's pull off a remarkable 0-24 to 2-17 victory over Ballyhale Shamrocks this evening at Croke Park to capture their first Leinster club senior hurling championship title.

item.title: 'Ballyboden gives us identity in a huge city, and we're so grateful to be part of that'
item.description: Ballyboden St Enda's manager Eamon O'Reilly has hit at the "super club" tag that people attach to big clubs in Dublin.

item.title: McNicholl strikes late to seal Ulster club IFC title for Glenullin
item.description: Glenullin (Derry) landed the Ulster club intermediate football championship title thanks to a 3-15 to 0-19 win over Cuchulainns (Cavan) at St Tiernach's Park, Clones.

item.title: First-half goals lead Davidstown-Courtnacuddy past Clane to Leinster club JHC crown
item.description: Three first-half goals helped propel Davidstown-Courtnacuddy (Wexford) to a 3-12 to 0-11 victory over Clane (Kildare) in Hawkfield this afternoon as they claimed the Leinster club junior hurling championship title.

item.title: Watch: Kilkenny legend Hogan helps Danesfort to Leinster glory with late goal off the bench
item.description: Danesfort (Kilkenny) captured the Leinster club intermediate hurling championship title with a 2-15 to 0-12 win against Ratoath (Meath) at Pairc Tailteann this afternoon.

item.title: Watch: Late drama as Geaney's two-point free snatches Munster club SFC crown for Dingle
item.description: Dingle triumphed to their first Munster club senior football championship title after edging out St Finbarr's in Thurles this afternoon.
